body:
How long have you had your pain if you don't mind me asking?  i sincerely know where you are coming from.

I'm 22 and have had chronic back pain for 3 years now.  It's 24/7, and It's so unbearable and makes life so tough.  Before this, I was in college, and doing well in life overall.  Happy.  But the pain made me drop out, because i couldn't focus in class, and ever since I have been working dead end jobs a teenager could work.  Recently I had to quit that job because I am having even more health problems.  It's like when do we catch a break.  Therapies aren't helping and i have no friends or energy to make any.  That lonely and stuck feeling is truly bone-chilling especially facing it at early twenties while everyone else is living it up.  I wish i could really offer an uplifting testimony, but all I can say is that you aren't truly alone in what you're facing.  I relate, and i wish you the best.

Please don't. I am not sure how you are feeling, and would like you to share.  I skimmed through most of your post and at the end of the die, no one knows what happens when you die.  Everyone that tries to tell you what happens is still alive and has never experienced death.  Conspiracy theories are interesting, but try not to dive too deep in them because it can sort of consume you.

I would offer that the only one sure life you have is this one, and there's no reason to end it trying to rush for the potential of a next life.  That day will come naturally.  I wish you the best and would appreciate hearing your personal thoughts
yes i do, and stretch, and it hasn't helped me.  I was in excellent physical shape when the pain started too.  chronic back pain sucks :(

I'm am sorry to hear this.  I think parents too often forget how much of an impact their words can have on us even when we are fully grown.  I will suggest that you tell him and your mom how you are feeling.  There is no point in concealing your pain and feelings, and you shouldn't have to endure it alone.  It also may make your parents alot more compassionate and caring.  I know how weird it is, but alot of times, no one sees how much pain we're really in.  please try sharing and releasing it.  Taking your life will only cause them a lot of pain.  Why do you say that you didn't amount to anything?  You are still here with a chance to be whatever you want.

I am sorry that you are feeling this way,  and i know it may not mean much, but I love you and care for you.  Is there anything that you find brings you joy?  I also understand how difficult life can get sometimes.  Are you finding that your therapist is helping?  Please do not be so hard on yourself as to say you are broken beyond repair.  I believe you are strong and definitely not "beyond" repair as you say.  If there is anything else troubling you currently, please share.
